mentions.name: BigJuJuMap
mentions.description: A special UIKit map package designed to be integrated into SwiftUI, providing map support to compensate for SwiftUI's weak native mapping capabilities. The author polished and documented it as a standalone reusable component after breaking it out of other work.
mentions.problem: SwiftUI map support is a big Achilles heel, being virtually non-existent natively.
mentions.source_excerpt: It’s a special UIKit map package, designed to be integrated into SwiftUI, as map support is a big SwiftUI Achilles heel.
